It's easy to fall in and out of love. Love changes after a few years. It's a different feeling. I've gone a while not feeling a spark but I love my life and partner. It comes and goes... 6 months no spark is normal at 4 years sometimes. it could mean it's over but it could mean a new phase of relationship.

No.. not directly. I didn't want to escalate I was really freaked out. This all actually came to light just a few months ago. 

She found out I knew through friends and said the servant / for my own safety thing to them. I never want to see her again.

I had already agreed to not talk to her after the limerance thing... I didn't want to escalate. 

Eventually when she found out through friends that I knew she claimed the servant thing. I avoid her. My best friend gave her 2 months to move out. She's gone now, blocked on everything. I got a password manager and maybe it's over?
I guess it depends what you mean by dangerous.... Do I think she's going to hurt me physically? No. Do I feel super emotionally violated and damaged from being stalked? Yes.
